WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id,CASE WHEN provenance->>'authoringRelationship' IN ('ORIGINAL','REVISION','COPY') THEN NULL ELSE source_release_id END AS source_release_id,ARRAY[id] AS path FROM measurement_content_releases WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) UNION ALL SELECT r.id,CASE WHEN r.provenance->>'authoringRelationship' IN ('ORIGINAL','REVISION','COPY') THEN NULL ELSE r.source_release_id END,a.path||r.id FROM measurement_content_releases r JOIN ancestors a ON r.id=a.source_release_id WHERE NOT r.id=ANY(a.path) AND cardinality(a.path)<100 ) SELECT id,bool_or(cardinality(path)>=100 AND source_release_id IS NOT NULL) AS truncated FROM ancestors GROUP BY id ORDER BY id
